# About

The data catalog describes the tables available to analysts. It is distinct from
the metrics cookbook; the cookbook explains how to *derive* metrics, while the
catalog describes the *tables* those metrics are calculated from, field by field.

## [Relying Parties](rp.qmd)

Reference tables in the `rp` schema that identify the services using CanadaLogin and their various aliases.

- [`service`](rp.qmd#service) - one row per relying party, with its names, operator, and launch date
- [`alias`](rp.qmd#alias) - the names each source system uses for a service, mapped back to one `rp_id`

## [IBM Verify](ibm_verify.qmd)

Derived tables in the `ibm_verify` schema, pulled from the IBM Verify reporting API.

- [`app_login_counts`](ibm_verify.qmd#app_login_counts) - daily sign-in counts by application
- [`auth_total_logins`](ibm_verify.qmd#auth_total_logins) - daily, CanadaLogin-wide sign-in totals
- [`mfa_activity`](ibm_verify.qmd#mfa_activity) - multi-factor authentication activity by factor and result

## [Call Centre](call_centre.qmd)

Weekly call centre data extracted from the CanadaLogin support weekly Excel reports.

- [`weekly_activity_report`](call_centre.qmd#weekly_activity_report) - weekly call volume and service-level summary
- [`weekly_topic_dump`](call_centre.qmd#weekly_topic_dump) - individual call records with topic classifications

## [Platform](sre.qmd)

Site reliability metrics for the CanadaLogin platform, in the `sre` schema. Currently incident-response tables, with other reliability measures to follow.

- [`mttr_current`](sre.qmd#mttr_current) - latest state of every incident, one row per incident
- [`mttr_history`](sre.qmd#mttr_history) - dated snapshots of every incident, preserving how each evolved

## [Google Analytics](google_analytics.qmd)

Tables in the `google_analytics` schema, populated from the CanadaLogin GA4 property.

- [`property_traffic`](google_analytics.qmd#property_traffic) - property-wide daily traffic, one row per day
- [`page_traffic`](google_analytics.qmd#page_traffic) - daily traffic by page title and path
- [`funnels`](google_analytics.qmd#funnels) - step-by-step counts for each defined GA4 funnel
- [`funnels_current`](google_analytics.qmd#funnels_current) - `funnels`, resolved to each date's current funnel version
- [`funnel_metrics`](google_analytics.qmd#funnel_metrics) - derived metrics computed from funnel rows, such as task success rate
- [`funnel_metrics_current`](google_analytics.qmd#funnel_metrics_current) - `funnel_metrics`, resolved to each date's current funnel version
